notes: Twenty-five source and fifty target tokens partitioned exactly once, in twenty-eight units.
Three targets are added: the two relatives supplied for finite clauses juxtaposed to written antecedents, which rule 46's last clause sends to rule 55, and the italic saying.
The head of the מַבְכִּירָה unit is the verse's one genuinely contestable choice and is argued in its note.

אוֹי takes Woe is as the clause's overt anchor while its לְ is unrepresented under rule 40 and the suffix takes me; the competing reading gives the copula to the preposition under rule 49, but the ASV writes nothing else for it.
נָא is rendered here by now rather than by an entreaty formula, so rule 30's last paragraph adds no pronouns to its unit.
